name: ReviewRequest for WooCommerce
author: wpreviewpro

sections.description:
ReviewRequest helps WooCommerce store owners collect more customer reviews by making it simple to send review request emails.

With a single click, you can send a personalized email to your customer asking them to leave a review after their purchase.

Features

Add a “Send Review Request” button to WooCommerce orders

Send manual review request emails to customers

Simple and lightweight setup

Works directly inside WooCommerce order admin

External services

This plugin connects to the Google Places API to retrieve business rating and review data.

What the service is used for:To fetch rating and review information from Google for display purposes.

What data is sent and when:

The Place ID and API key are sent when requesting review and rating data

Requests are made when the plugin fetches Google review information

Service provider: Google LLC

Terms of Service:https://policies.google.com/terms

Privacy Policy:https://policies.google.com/privacy

How It Works

Install and activate the plugin

Go to WooCommerce → Orders

Open any order

Click the “Send Review Request” button

The customer receives an email asking for a review

Donate Link

If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting development:https://example.com
sections.installation:
Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/reviewrequest/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress

Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce? =Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I customize the email? =This version provides a default email template.

Does this plugin use external services? =Yes, it uses the Google Places API to retrieve review and rating data.
